verdict.rationale: Event-triggered automation rules are a fair axis for an AI app-building platform, but the evidence pack never documents defining rules that fire actions when events occur. The closest item is scheduled routines (replit-docs-49). A recurring time-based schedule is a different capability from event-driven triggers, so it earns no credit here, and background tasks and MCP integrations are likewise unrelated.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
